_format: Canonical shape of ai_skill_anchors/pwa.json. Scaffold this into the project and fill the ALL_CAPS placeholders by ANALYZING the project (see SKILL.md Step 2), then confirm every value with the user via AskUserQuestion. Use ONLY these keys — do not invent others. Code reads: reports_root + app_dir (create-reports-directory / verify-pwa / audit-lighthouse) and routes (audit-responsive); the rest is the skill<->project bridge / documentation.
project: YOUR_PROJECT_NAME (the app's package/display name; read package.json)
production_url: PRODUCTION_URL_OR_null (deployed origin to optionally audit; ASK THE USER)
reports_root: REPORTS_ROOT_RELATIVE_TO_PROJECT_ROOT (ASK THE USER; reports go to <reports_root>/pwa_scores; NEVER a root-level or cwd folder)
app_dir: APP_DIR_RELATIVE_TO_PROJECT_ROOT (the Vite app root that holds index.html + package.json; verify-pwa builds it and audit-lighthouse runs from it)
routes: FILL_AFTER_ANALYZING_THE_ROUTER — the PUBLIC routes to audit for responsiveness; DO NOT copy blindly, derive from the app's route table. Example (smritea-cloud-ui): "/", "/product", "/examples", "/pricing", "/auth/login", "/auth/register"

mobile_nav_check._doc: OPTIONAL. When the app has a marketing hamburger, audit-responsive asserts it OPENS on mobile. route = the marketing/home route; trigger_label = the hamburger button's accessible name (case-insensitive regex); reveal_link = a nav link name that must appear once open. OMIT this whole key for apps with no mobile hamburger.
